import unittest
from collections import UserDict
from solution import merge_directory


class MergeDirectoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_order_duplicates_and_missing(self):
        directory = {"a": {"value": 1}, "b": {"value": 2}}
        result = merge_directory(["b", "missing", "a", "b"], directory)
        self.assertEqual(result, (
            {"key": "b", "found": True, "data": {"value": 2}},
            {"key": "missing", "found": False, "data": None},
            {"key": "a", "found": True, "data": {"value": 1}},
            {"key": "b", "found": True, "data": {"value": 2}},
        ))

    def test_deep_copy_per_duplicate_and_input_independence(self):
        nested = {"items": [{"x": 1}]}
        directory = {"a": nested}
        result = merge_directory((key for key in ["a", "a"]), directory)
        nested["items"][0]["x"] = 9
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["data"]["items"][0]["x"], 1)
        result[0]["data"]["items"].append({"x": 2})
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["data"]["items"], [{"x": 1}])
        result[0]["data"]["items"][0]["x"] = 7
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["data"]["items"][0]["x"], 1)

    def test_empty_and_general_mapping(self):
        self.assertEqual(merge_directory([], {}), ())
        self.assertEqual(merge_directory(["x"], UserDict({"x": {"ok": True}}))[0]["data"], {"ok": True})

    def test_entire_directory_is_validated_even_for_unused_entries(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            merge_directory(["good"], {"good": {}, 3: {}})
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            merge_directory([], {"bad": []})

    def test_malformed_inputs(self):
        for keys in ("abc", b"abc"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                merge_directory(keys, {})
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            merge_directory([], [])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            merge_directory(["ok", 2], {"ok": {}})
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            merge_directory(123, {})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
